title: The Seven-Day Pact Stuns the World
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji spoke the words 'Within seven days, I want all intelligence on the Demonic Path commander,' Ye Qing's lips curved slightly—this was exactly the answer she wanted.

text.content: The blood droplet hovered in midair, glowing with a faint golden shimmer, forming an eerie standoff with the surging demonic energy around Ye Qing. Chen Ji stared at the faint wound on his palm, a deep, barely perceptible contemplation flickering in his eyes. In that instant, he clearly felt something awakening within him—a power from the depths of his bloodline, yet so foreign, as if a giant beast that had slumbered for a thousand years had just opened its first eye.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing wiped the blood from her lips, her eyes gleaming with uncertainty. She stepped forward slowly, the demonic energy around her coiling like waves, and her gaze toward Chen Ji had transformed entirely—mingled with scrutiny, surprise, and an irrepressible eagerness. 'Interesting... A worthless servant from Tianqing Sect, yet harboring a bloodline that can suppress my demonic arts.' Her voice carried a playful tone, 'Chen Ji, who exactly are you?'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hand, tucking the bloodstain into his sleeve. His expression remained calm, as if what had just occurred was merely a trivial accident. Deep within, the pages of the Tianji Record glowed faintly—it was reminding him that the bloodline mutation would consume Heavenly Fate Value. However, at this moment, what concerned him more was another matter: How did this Demonic Path Saint know his name?

dialogue.content: 'Your Highness the Saint's information network is quite efficient.' Chen Ji raised his gaze, his eyes calm as a deep ancient well, 'A servant disciple from Tianqing Sect, yet you personally made the trip—I feel truly honored.' His tone was neither servile nor arrogant, his lips even carrying a faint, nonchalant sneer, 'Could it be that the Holy Demonic Sect's intelligence network has become so meticulous that even an ant is not overlooked?'

Ye Qing laughed lightly, the sound clear as silver bells, yet carrying an eerie chill. She waved her hand, and an invisible barrier enveloped the two of them. Her voice dropped several tones: 'Chen Ji, I don't have time to beat around the bush with you. Today I came to propose a deal.' She paused, her gaze burning intently on him, 'Regarding your bloodline... and that thing in your hands.'

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, alarm bells ringing in his heart. The aura of the Tianji Record had been perfectly concealed by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul—how did this Demonic Path Saint learn of it? His expression unchanged, his palm quietly gathered a thread of True Qi. On the surface, he still wore that harmless, timid facade; only the fingers hidden in his sleeves had tightened slightly, knuckles whitening.

dialogue.content: 'Your Highness the Saint, I don't understand what you're saying.' Chen Ji stepped back half a pace, an appropriate expression of fear appearing on his face, 'What bloodline, what thing... I'm just a cleaning servant, if Your Highness has come to the wrong person...' His voice trembled slightly, his acting truly impeccable. Internally, however, he was rapidly calculating: Where did her intelligence come from? Was it a bluff, or did she truly possess something?

'Have you had enough of the act?' Ye Qing's voice turned suddenly cold and sharp, the demonic energy around her surging violently like terrifying waves pressing toward Chen Ji. Yet just as the dark energy touched the space three feet around him, that faint golden glow appeared once more, completely isolating the black mist. A flicker of wariness crossed her eyes as she withdrew her aura, 'Three months ago, on the Northern Wasteland, you foresaw a catastrophe that should never have been seen—am I right?'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart lurched violently, yet his expression remained unmoved. That foresight had occurred after the Tianji Record's third page was unsealed. He had dismissed the sect's inquiry with the excuse of 'passing by coincidentally,' never expecting to be targeted by the Demonic Path Saint. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the pages trembled slightly, as if warning him of something. He took a deep breath, deciding to change his strategy.

dialogue.content: 'Since Your Highness the Saint knows so much, why bother asking?' Chen Ji slowly straightened his spine, that timid aura receding like a tide, replaced by a chilling steadiness that would make one's heart palpitate. He met Ye Qing's gaze directly, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips, 'Go ahead, what do you want?'

A flash of appreciation appeared in Ye Qing's eyes. She clasped her hands behind her back, the demonic energy condensing into a vague shadow behind her—a mysterious general clad in black armor. 'Within the Holy Demonic Sect, someone is plotting against you.' Her voice was low, 'And that person has inextricable ties to the very thing you seek. I need someone who can see through the future to help me break the deadlock.'

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression unchanged, yet his heart was churning like a tumultuous sea. Someone within the Demonic Path is connected to the Tianji Record? Fragments of what Mo Xiansheng had mentioned before swiftly passed through his mind—the Tianji Record is not unique in this world; there are other prophetic treasures. He gazed at the black-armored shadow, his eyes narrowing slightly. This intelligence was invaluable.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing had thrown out the olive branch of cooperation, yet the chips she held seemed far heavier than imagined. Chen Ji needed to make a choice—this was a dangerous game with the Demonic Path Saint; one misstep would mean utter destruction.

choices.description: Forming an alliance with the Demonic Path Saint to fulfill the Seven-Day Pact. This was a high-stakes gamble, but high risk often meant high reward.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Intelligence and Resource Support from the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed for cooperating with the Demonic Path, one's reputation will be ruined

text.content: Chen Ji沉吟片刻，忽而轻笑出声：'Your Highness the Saint is quite straightforward.' He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his eyes gleaming, 'But cooperation is a two-way street—if you wish to borrow my eyes, you must show sufficient sincerity.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, her smile deepening several degrees: 'You are more interesting than I imagined. Go ahead, what kind of sincerity do you want?'

choices.memory_label: 与夜清初步达成合作意向

choices.description: Not immediately agreeing, but proposing harsh conditions to test the other party's bottom line. Only this fits his style of flawless calculation.
choices.risk_hint: May Anger Ye Qing, Leading to Negotiation Breakdown

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately; instead, he paced slowly under Ye Qing's scrutinizing gaze. His silence itself was a form of pressure—a worthless servant would never possess such bearing. After a moment, he stopped, his voice flat yet carrying an unmistakable edge: 'Within seven days, I want all intelligence on the Demonic Path commander—including any possible connections to the Tianji Record.'

dialogue.content: A flash of sharpness crossed Ye Qing's eyes; Chen Ji's words hit the mark perfectly. What she had been waiting for was exactly this—a truly ambitious, intelligent collaborator, not some indecisive turncoat. 'Done.' She agreed干脆利落地, extending her right hand, 'The Seven-Day Pact begins from this moment.'

choices.memory_label: 与夜清达成七日之约，提出情报交换条件

choices.description: Those of the Demonic Path cannot be trusted; the risks of cooperation are too great. Maintaining distance and observing quietly is the wisest course.
choices.risk_hint: May Miss Important Intelligence and Offend the Demonic Path Saint

dialogue.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his expression serene yet conveying an unshakable firmness: 'I appreciate Your Highness the Saint's kindness, but I am merely a worthless servant. Cooperating with the Demonic Path... the risks are too great, I cannot bear it.' His voice was humble, yet his tone was resolute, leaving no room for negotiation.

Ye Qing's smile stiffened slightly, then transformed into a sigh: 'What a pity.' She turned to leave but paused at the edge of the barrier, 'However, Chen Ji, I advise you one thing—some things cannot be avoided simply because you wish to hide. That commander... has already taken notice of you.' With those words, her figure vanished within the demonic energy.

choices.memory_label: 拒绝夜清合作，但收到魔道主帅关注警告

text.content: The barrier dissipated, and night once again shrouded this wilderness. Chen Ji stood alone in the wind, his robes fluttering. He slowly opened his right hand; the wound on his palm had healed, yet leaving behind a faint golden scar—the mark of bloodline awakening. The pages of the Tianji Record fluttered gently in the depths of his consciousness, and Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted forth: 'Your bloodline... is indeed connected to that thing. This game, you are playing faster than this old man anticipated.'

Chen Ji offered no reply, only raising his gaze toward the depths of the night sky. The Demonic Path commander, connections to the Tianji Record, his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts... all clues pointed in the same direction. He slowly clenched his fist, knuckles whitening. After so many years of hiding his true strength while appearing weak, it was time to accelerate his布局. In the distance, the morning bells and evening drums faintly echoed from the direction of Tianqing Sect—a new day was about to begin, and his chess game had only just revealed its first page.
